description: After his February 1972 guest-of-honor speech at the Vancouver SFCon (the 'Android and the Human' speech) and a documented suicide attempt, PKD entered the X-Kalay drug rehabilitation program in Vancouver. He stayed briefly. The period is associated with what he subsequently called a 'spiritual crisis' but no single theophany is canonically attached. Some Exegesis segments retrospectively read the Vancouver despair as the precondition for the 2-3-74 events two years later.

pkd_interpretations.interpretation: I had a breakdown; X-Kalay is helping.
The Vancouver despair was the necessary precondition for the 2-3-74 opening; without the bottom there would have been no transformation.

scholar_interpretations.interpretation: Sutin treats Vancouver as a documented mental-health crisis with a specifiable date and place.
Arnold places Vancouver in his clinical chronology as a major depressive episode.

contradiction_zone: yes — Vancouver is on the registered dispute zones (timeline of suicide attempt, X-Kalay duration)
